I've been using it since they made it. Not sure what issues there would be that they warn you about.

To use it:

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:graphics-drivers/ppa

sudo apt-get update

sudo apt-get dist-upgrade

Or after adding it and updating the package list, just use the Additional Drivers tool to pick the driver you want to use if you aren't already using one of the proprietary drivers. To remove it, just use ppa-purge. It's just a PPA, like any other one.
